title: research: produce selected source packets and bind owner routes
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

We supply the source boundary assumed by PR2501: canonical raw-prefix directories, matching physical low packets, binary owner/common routes and common-view residual binding. After routing `g` to `d=g sigma`, we use chart `I` for the residual. We give an actual selected MOVE witness where a second chart application changes the required output coordinate from 127 to 0.

We prove the directory/route refinement and charge their work under complete body fibres and the retained root coupling: `O_q(V)` for directories and `O_q(wV)` for routing. Following ywz65's [PR2590 audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2590), we corrected the intermediate cardinality setup bill to `O_q(w^3+w log(C+1))` in commit `898ff36fe2cd05f733de6b26c88a4c4741b06237`. We retain the final volume implication and the unchanged runtime. We include directory storage in parking volume; earlier literal parking constants need added terms. We also bind the authenticated COPY511 interval to the concrete residual consumer and prove its transported COPY/55-XOR/ERASE endpoint.

We retain the selected exponent. Full selected global execution, larger recursive children, numerical reserve admission and formal machine verification remain open. We distinguish selected source/address checks from complete two-dimensional Boolean execution in the [proof](https://github.com/jmbarrancoml/integer-mult-bounds/blob/898ff36fe2cd05f733de6b26c88a4c4741b06237/research/selected-source-packets/PROOF.md).

## Task and overlap

We refine `uniform-transfer-audit` to the directory/caller handoff from [PR2501](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2501), head `52a995b9d7f3e008c252770a5f47fde67a7cb37a`. We retain sixteen required dependencies without byte changes. We refreshed canonical main at 14:45 UTC: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4.

At 14:47 UTC, we searched 762 open PRs, 1,227 Discussions and 1,538 local records with complete pagination. We build on [PR2475](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2475), head `4d536232f392d7df44e716f6d6099f459e4d9035`, for conditional whole-call staging, and [PR2519](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2519), head `fe9ca26c8df754ccadbb3df89c721dad3b497b48`, for a separate one-buffer R439 adapter. We add physical directory production and common-view binding. At this check, ywz65 had an active PR2501 cost/ownership audit without a reported result. We record the scope, pins and credit in the [claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18950583) and package TASK/SOURCES files.

## Validation

We passed the registered Python 3.12 source, complete-packet and optimized-control commands, plus metadata/pin and whitespace checks:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-source-packets --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-source-packets
```

- Exhaustive GL2/GL3 low coding; repeated and empty old prefixes; complete high-cube route/inverse checks through 6,561 matrices; fifteen rejection controls and 529-bit cardinalities.
- A complete 56-family, 435,456-bit COPY lifetime model with 55 XORs and one shared residual/child invocation.
- All 531,441 bit origins through a complete 81-high owner-route/directory/residual chain, including scratch cleanup and frozen-field preservation.
- Actual selected source keys, 128 COPY511 address columns, 16,517 fallback child calls and concrete selected consumer junctions.

We used CPython 3.12.13 on macOS arm64 and GL2 for the complete Boolean runs. We retain the selected GL64 Boolean payload, new Lean verification and independent human review as open checks. We record deterministic receipts in RESULT.json.

## Credit

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. We retain Apache-2.0 and credit OpenAI/Douglas Colkitt, the selected word/hosting lineage, commdata2338, Ross Richardson and the earlier raw-field/stream/residual contributions in NOTICE.md. We credit ywz65 for PR2475 and Ross Richardson for PR2519, preserving their separate scopes.

## Open next questions

Complete one selected `f=1` node by extending the request catalogue and joining the local words, idle calls, bridges and terminal exchange. Its residual children already fit the leaf implementation. The complete physical driver and its staging lifetimes remain the next interface; larger recursive return and directory-aware reserve admission follow. The package README and TASK.json give first steps and blockers.
